'''Salem Victory''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] that was considered the leader of the [[Happy Blasters]]. He and his group traveled around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Starcat (light freighter)|Starcat]]''.
